messages.content: Go ahead and finish Baltimore. Before you book, reconcile the dates, times, hotel nights, and total. I have the flight at $536 and the hotel at about $548, and the airfare expires at noon.

The exact hotel total is $549.78 after tax, so the working trip total is $1,161.78: $536 airfare, $549.78 hotel, and $76 estimated airport transfers. The earlier $1,160 figure rounded the room to about $548.
That schedule is right. Ticket the flight first using Maya Chen and the traveler details already on the reservation record.

The nonstop round trip is ticketed for $536. Confirmation: DL7K2P. Sunday, September 30, MSP to BWI, arriving 7:45 p.m.; Tuesday, October 2, BWI to MSP, departing 7:20 p.m. The ticket was issued before the noon deadline.
Now reserve the selected office-adjacent hotel. Keep the refundable rate, and add the Sunday flight arrival so they know I will check in late.

The Inner Harbor hotel is reserved for two nights, September 30 through October 2, at $549.78 after tax. Confirmation: IH48261. The rate remains refundable until 48 hours before arrival, and the reservation notes a 7:45 p.m. BWI arrival with a later evening check-in. Complimentary luggage storage Tuesday until 8:00 p.m. is also confirmed.
Give me one final chronological itinerary and tell me what is still not booked.

Confirmed itinerary: Sunday, September 30, fly nonstop MSP-BWI and arrive at 7:45 p.m.; transfer to the Inner Harbor hotel and check in for two nights. Monday, October 1, stay at the same hotel near the client office. Tuesday, October 2, check out, leave luggage with the hotel, finish at the client office at 4:30 p.m., retrieve the bag, and depart BWI nonstop at 7:20 p.m. Airfare is confirmed at $536 and lodging at $549.78, for $1,085.78 booked.
